geometry_edits.rationale: Convert the single bent body into a split-wing massing so the composition can hold a clearer court and public threshold without losing dominance.
Keep the split oriented to the verified access side so the opening aligns with the public edge logic.
Introduce a readable but restrained gap to form a usable open-space figure rather than a decorative notch.
Preserve continuity across the split with a bridge so the form remains one dominant massing idea.
Retain the access-aligned lift condition to keep the public threshold on the verified frontage side.
Strengthen the undercroft/entry seam with a slightly higher lift for better ground porosity.

rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent early massing with one dominant bent body and a protected lift/public-threshold condition, so it clears the hard program gate for neighborhood living. It responds to the parcel more convincingly than a simple box because the footprint is irregular and the mass is not merely filling the bounding frame. That said, the public void is only moderately legible: the lifted condition is present, but the open-space figure is not yet strongly carved as a court or entry seam in all views. The form is coherent across the four views and I do not see obvious view-to-view collisions, but the silhouette remains somewhat generic and blocky in section, with limited roof/section expression for active neighborhood threshold logic. The access edge response is present but could be more emphatic as a clear public ground opening toward the verified frontage. Overall: passable, program-aligned, but still needs stronger carved void and cleaner threshold articulation.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: C-shaped / folded low-rise massing with a clear central void and a bridge-like upper connection, while keeping the ground condition open.
